autotile.description: Eight-bit neighbour mask; a bit is set when that neighbour holds the same terrain. Diagonal bits are cleared unless both adjoining cardinal bits are set, collapsing 256 masks onto 47 variants.

menu.label: Throne hall
menu.name: throne_hall
menu.summary: A hall by lamplight: a dark roof, stone above and below a beam, and a carpeted dais. For a court scene in any setting that has one: medieval, sengoku, or a governor's house in pirates.

menu.label: Night camp
menu.name: night_camp
menu.summary: A field under a night sky, a treeline on the horizon, and firelight on the ground at the player's feet. The between-battles backdrop: medieval, nature and sengoku all camp.

menu.label: Deep wood
menu.name: deep_wood
menu.summary: Under a canopy: three depths of leaf closing overhead, wet ground beneath, and leaf litter at the foot. For nature and mythical, and for any march that leaves the road.

menu.label: Mountain dusk
menu.name: mountain_dusk
menu.summary: Ridges at dusk: a violet sky, two ranges falling away, and pines at the foot of the near one. Drawn for sengoku and mythical, and the one backdrop that reads as distance.

menu.label: Open sea
menu.name: open_sea
menu.summary: Night water under a night sky, with a rail in the foreground so the scene is aboard something rather than adrift. For pirates, and for any crossing.

menu.label: Star field
menu.name: star_field
menu.summary: The void, a nebula across it, and a hull along the bottom of the frame. For scifi, and the only backdrop in the library with no ground in it.

menu.label: Crypt
menu.name: crypt
menu.summary: Stone underground: a vault overhead, a wall with bone set in it, and char at the floor. Drawn for undead, and it suits every mythical scene that happens below ground.

menu.label: Male
menu.name: first
menu.summary: The male body, and the sprite that shipped before there was a second one.

menu.label: Female
menu.name: second
menu.summary: The female body: the same role and the same kit, carried by a woman — a different line from shoulder to hem, and hair where the headgear leaves room.

cells.label: Walk: contact
cells.name: walk_contact
cells.summary: The down-beat: weight landing, feet apart, the body at its lowest.

cells.label: Walk: pass
cells.name: walk_pass
cells.summary: The up-beat: the body back at standing height with a foot swinging past it, which is what makes the pair a cycle.

cells.label: Lunge
cells.name: lunge
cells.summary: The body leaned into a blow, feet planted, over the six frames a landed hit already takes.

cells.label: Cast
cells.name: cast
cells.summary: The body holding itself still around a spell: the head held where it stood, the torso settled under it and both feet drawn off the ground.

menu.label: Medieval
menu.name: medieval
menu.summary: Plate, longbows and staves: the high-fantasy roster.

menu.label: Sci-fi
menu.name: scifi
menu.summary: Powered armour, rail rifles and drones: the same roster in a war fleet.

menu.label: Mythical
menu.name: mythical
menu.summary: Scale, horn and dragonfire: the same roster among dragonkin.

menu.label: Nature
menu.name: nature
menu.summary: Animal folk: the same roster carried by badgers, cats, bears and a boar.

menu.label: Sengoku Japan
menu.name: sengoku
menu.summary: Lacquer, the naginata and the yumi: the same roster in the Warring States.

menu.label: Undead
menu.name: undead
menu.summary: Bone, shroud and rust: the same roster as the force a player fights.

menu.label: Pirates
menu.name: pirates
menu.summary: Tar, brass and sailcloth: the same roster as a ship's crew.

profile.label: Nintendo 64 CI4
profile.name: n64_ci4
profile.notes: 4bpp indexed against a per-asset 16-colour TLUT bank chosen from the master palette. Power-of-two dimensions; CI4 for mksprite.

menu.label: Temperate
menu.name: temperate
menu.summary: Green fields, blue water, dark evergreen woods.

menu.label: Autumn
menu.name: autumn
menu.summary: A dry golden field under a russet canopy.

menu.label: Winter
menu.name: winter
menu.summary: Frost over the ground, blue-green pine, water gone to ice.

menu.label: Ashland
menu.name: ashland
menu.summary: Burnt scrub, charred woods, ash where the sand was.
